titulo: Point the remote at the ceiling

frases.texto: Your TV remote still works when you point it at the ceiling.
The light misses the TV, bounces off the paint, and the channel changes.
It isn't a laser. It spreads, like a flashlight.
Back up twice as far, and that splash gets four times fainter.
Shove it under a cushion, and the light never gets out.
That's why a remote lost in the couch does nothing.
The first wireless remote had to hit one corner of the screen.
That corner was the button. Miss it, and the set just sat there.
Today the blinks are the button, so a bounce still counts.
Your phone can change the channel without pointing.
The app is in the link in bio.
Send it to that friend who aims the remote at the ceiling.
